## Earnie 2.6.2

Official PATCH after community candidate **2.6.2-beta.1** (hotfix line from **2.6.0**; supersedes declined **2.6.1** candidate). Updates GHCR `:latest` after you approve **promote**.

### Highlights

- **Energy-Charts 503 / Monitor crash:** live Day-Ahead fallback no longer `NameError`s on `MARKET_ZONE_CH`; aWATTar is used when Energy-Charts is unavailable (e.g. HTTP 503)
- **[#24](https://github.com/JochenTCC/Earnie/issues/24) hourly Gesamt-CSV:** Path B residual holds hourly power across 15‑min slots (ZOH) instead of quartering energy
- **[#24](https://github.com/JochenTCC/Earnie/issues/24) HA tariffs path:** add-on sidecars stay under `EARNIE_CONFIG_PATH` (`/config`)
- **Catalog:** remove plant-date-dependent EEG fixed feed-in row — use **Eigener Festpreis** for site-specific rates
- **Unified power sign convention:** `P_cons = P_PV + P_Grid + P_Bat` with battery `+` = discharge (HA/OpenEMS/Loxone)

### Please check (HA / Loxone)

- **Home Assistant:** battery entity must be **positive while discharging** (review any old `ehal.ha.sign` negation)
- **Loxone:** `Earnie_Batterie_Leistung` **positive while discharging**; Huawei 37113/37765 must both be negated in Loxone

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.6.2`, `:next`, and `:latest` after you approve **promote**
- Prod compose: `docker/compose/synology_productive.yml` / `loxberry_productive.yml` / `proxmox_productive.yml` (`:latest`)

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology_productive.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology_productive.yml up -d
```

HA add-on: official channel (`earnie`) is pinned when **promote** completes.
